profiles.rule: Import the exact original per-owner dependency DAG; the coarse rank does not remove original command/reverse-claim/root constraints; reject unresolved union cycles.

resource_identity: Physical databaseBinding + database principal + exact lock resource bytes or row/range predicate identity; owner alias strings never create distinct locks for the same resource.
lock_rules: Precollect complete canonical/source/route/metric/claim/authority membership including absent-key guards
Coalesce physical aliases and use strongest S/X before first acquisition
Include implicit UPDATE/FK/trigger/unique-index/predicate locks and allocator locks in the registry DAG
Acquire deterministic registered topological order; mandatory rank edges are not removable
SCOPE parent before all children across every warehouse/site; DETAIL use accepted global ordinal owner/key ordering
No upgrades, no acquire earlier rank after later; reentry allowed only same native outer transaction, same physical resource and sufficient held mode
Membership changed under gate: rollback entire operation, recollect outside locks, retry same business identity
Cross database/connection/provider/unknown writer coverage: REQUIRED_FENCED, no distributed atomicity inference
New writer route may register only under exclusive catalogue/control gate; tombstoned correction root cannot gain executable aliases
No automatic fairness or timeout expiry inference: lock failure rolls back; outcome unknown queries original operation
